gene_statistic: GeneLab Wald stat (Stat_ column) for the five vendored contrasts; for OSD-522 the PyDESeq2 Wald stat recomputed from raw counts as the first study did (6 flight vs 6 ground shoots, genes with total count >= 10)

set_statistics.signed: mean gene statistic in the set minus the mean over all measured genes
set_statistics.unsigned: mean |gene statistic| in the set minus the mean |statistic| over all measured genes

primary_null.OSD-522: sample permutation: all 924 ways to label 6 of the 12 samples as flight; gene statistic a Welch t on log2(median-of-ratios normalised count + 1)
primary_null.other: genomic rotation: the set's gene positions shifted together by a random offset along the genome (KEGG order, prereg/gene_order.tsv.gz), preserving set size and clustering; 10000 offsets

p_two_sided: (1 + #{|null| >= |obs|}) / (B + 1) for rotation; #{|null| >= |obs|} / 924 for the sample permutation, which includes the observed labelling
p_one_sided: same with null >= obs, for the unsigned statistic
fdr_family: Benjamini-Hochberg across the 36 primary tests (6 sets x 6 contrasts)
verdict: observed = up/down (signed) or enriched (unsigned) when BH q < 0.05, else none; MATCH when observed equals the prediction
secondary: rotation null for OSD-522 as well; two-sided Mann-Whitney of set log2FC against all other genes (the first study's test); the non-primary statistic. Reported, not used for verdicts.

compound_rule.rule: a T06 prediction whose driver is net assimilation (A) or carbon starvation is compared with the T02 consensus direction: agrees if the signs match, disagrees if they differ, untested if T02 has no directional status for that KEGG ID
compound_rule.not_comparable: Vo- and RuBP-driven predictions: darkness stops oxygenation and carboxylation together, so a darkness reference cannot test them
compound_rule.note: T02 was built and inspected on 2026-10-30 before this file was written, so this comparison is a consistency check, not a blind test

paintomics.layer: all T02 compounds; value = direction x 0.13052 (the model's carbon-deficit magnitude, T06) for robust and single, 0 for none and conflicting; relevant = robust only
paintomics.label: ground carbon-starvation reference, not flight measurements
paintomics.job_A: OSD-522 gene and protein files byte-identical to job 1 (SHA-256 checked) + layer
paintomics.job_B: OSD-678-light genes (GeneLab log2FC; relevant = adjusted p < 0.05) + layer
paintomics.comparison: descriptive: pathways at combined-p BH FDR < 0.05 gained or lost, rank shifts, hubs at FDR < 0.05
paintomics.mechanistic_check: hub raw p-values for compounds relevant in both job 1 and job A are expected to be identical, because hub significance depends on the gene layer and the KEGG network, not on the metabolite values; FDR may differ because more compounds enter the family

power.variance: Col-0 wild-type control groups of MetaboLights GC-MS leaf or rosette studies; within-group SD of log2 intensity per metabolite, median across groups
power.test: two-sided two-sample t, equal n per arm, noncentral t
power.multiplicity: unadjusted and Bonferroni across the panel; BH lies between them
